episodeTitle.en: Building a world-class sales org | Jason Lemkin (SaaStr)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造世界级销售团队》 | 杰森·莱姆金（Jason Lemkin，SaaStr）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jason Lemkin created and runs SaaStr, the world’s largest community for B2B/SaaS founders, and is the managing director of SaaStr Fund, a $90 million venture capital firm specializing in early-stage enterprise investments. He is also the mastermind behind two major tech conferences each year—one in the Bay Area, drawing in over 15,000 people, and another in Europe, with a crowd of more than 3,000 SaaS executives, founders, and entrepreneurs. Before SaaStr, Jason wore many hats: CEO and co-founder of EchoSign (later bought by Adobe), vice president at Adobe Systems, co-founder and president of NanoGram Devices Corp., vice president of NeoPhotonics, and a senior director at BabyCenter. In our conversation, we discuss: • How far you should go without a salesperson
guestBioOfficial.zh:
杰森·莱姆金创立并运营着全球最大的B2B/SaaS创始人社区SaaStr，同时担任SaaStr Fund的董事总经理——这家规模达9000万美元的风投公司专注于早期企业投资。此外，他每年还主办两场大型科技会议：一场在湾区，吸引超过15,000人参与；另一场在欧洲，吸引了3,000多名SaaS高管、创始人和创业者。SaaStr之前，杰森曾担任过多个职位：EchoSign（后被Adobe收购）的首席执行官兼联合创始人、Adobe Systems的副总裁、NanoGram Devices Corp.的联合创始人兼总裁、NeoPhotonics的副总裁，以及BabyCenter的高级总监。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了以下内容：
• 何时应该在没有销售人员的情况下全力推进

title.en: Building a world-class sales org | Jason Lemkin (SaaStr)
title.zh: 《打造世界级销售团队》 | 杰森·莱姆金（Jason Lemkin，SaaStr）

summary.en: Jason gets extremely tactical about building a sales team—the area most product leaders lack experience in: how long to wait before hiring your first salesperson, why you should actually hire two, how to comp and interview them, and when to bring on a VP of sales. He covers how to keep reps from flaming out and burning cash, how to make the product–sales relationship healthier (with your head of product deeply involved), how long trials should be, and why to avoid annual contracts. The episode is a rich, extended masterclass drawn from Jason's hard-won SaaS experience.
summary.zh: Jason 就“组建销售团队”给出了极其具体的建议——这是大多数产品领导者最缺经验的领域：该等多久才招第一名销售、为何其实应该一次招两人、如何给他们定薪酬与面试、何时引入销售副总裁。他讲了如何避免销售员快速熄火、烧光现金，如何让产品与销售的关系更健康（让产品负责人深度参与），试用以期多长，以及为何要避免年度合同。这期节目是基于 Jason 来之不易的 SaaS 经验、内容极为丰富的长版公开课。
